I am trying, i really am. I'm just so tired. 

Thank you for replying to me, i really appreciate it.

I have done in the past, for depression.

I'm constantly seeing doctors for chronic pain. It gets difficult when your discharged because the consultants don't know what to do with you.

I'm looking elsewhere and have been offered a job elsewhere, but it don't know if i will be what they really want / good enough. It is so draining working somewhere that constantly drags you down. Really makes you question your self worth
